title.narrative: Provision of thematic analysis and advice by The Institute Of Development Studies.

description.narrative: This activity Provision of thematic analysis and advice by The Institute Of Development Studies. is a component of Institute Of Development Studies Provision of thematic analysis and advice reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £13,181,607. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Women's rights organisations and movements, and government institutions, Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution, Business policy and administration, Public sector policy and administrative management, Environmental policy and administrative management.
